part.text: {"program": [{"kind": "config_ex", "dataflow": 1}, {"kind": "config_ld", "slot": 0, "stride_bytes": 48, "scale": 1.0}, {"kind": "config_ld", "slot": 1, "stride_bytes": 48, "scale": 1.0}, {"kind": "config_st", "stride_bytes": 192}, {"for": "k", "start": 0, "stop": {"expr": "K // 16"}, "step": 1, "body": [{"for": "m", "start": 0, "stop": {"expr": "M // 16"}, "step": 1, "body": [{"kind": "mvin", "slot": 0, "buf": "A", "offset": {"expr": "m * 768 + k * 16"}, "spad_addr": {"expr": "m * 16"}, "cols": 16, "rows": 16}]}, {"for": "n", "start": 0, "stop": {"expr": "N // 16"}, "step": 1, "body": [{"kind": "mvin", "slot": 1, "buf": "B", "offset": {"expr": "k * 768 + n * 16"}, "spad_addr": 32, "cols": 16, "rows": 16}, {"for": "m", "start": 0, "stop": {"expr": "M // 16"}, "step": 1, "body": [{"kind": "preload", "bd_spad_addr": {"expr": "32 if m == 0 else 4294967295"}, "out_addr": {"expr": "2684354560 + m * 16 + (1073741824 if k > 0 else 0)"}}, {"kind": "compute", "accumulated": {"expr": "m == 1"}, "a_spad_addr": {"expr": "m * 16"}, "bd_spad_addr": 4294967295}, {"for": "t", "start": 0, "stop": {"expr": "1 if k == K // 16 - 1 else 0"}, "step": 1, "body": [{"kind": "mvout", "buf_offset": {"expr": "m * 768 + n * 16"}, "acc_addr": {"expr": "2684354560 + m * 16"}, "cols": 16, "rows": 16}]}]}]}]}, {"kind": "fence"}], "rationale": "K-outer ordering: each k-iteration first loads both A row-tiles into scratchpad rows 0-15/16-31 (persists across all n), then for each n loads B(k,n) to spad row 32 and computes both m-tiles. The m=0 compute stages B(k,n) via preload (accumulated=false), overwriting the accumulator at k=0 (out_addr bit30=0) or accumulating at k>0 (bit30=1); the m=1 compute reuses the latched B tile via a GARBAGE preload with accumulated=true. Every output tile therefore receives its three 16-deep partial products in strictly increasing K order (k=0 overwrite, k=1, k=2 accumulate), and the guarded mvout fires only on the last k. DMA traffic is minimal: each of the 6 A tiles and 9 B tiles is loaded exactly once (15 mvins, 3840 bytes), which is the lower bound since spad capacity (64 rows) cannot hold all A tiles across k. Command count is also minimal: 18 computes (one per output tile per k-tile), each requiring exactly one preload, plus 15 mvin, 6 mvout, 4 config, 1 fence = 62 commands."}
